title: Tensor decomposition for a finite Galois field extension
statement: Let $L$ be a field [def-pc-field-extension] and let $E/L$ be a finite Galois extension (finite and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], normal) with group $Q=\operatorname{Aut}_L(E)$ [def-pc-field-extension]; for $q\in Q$ write $\operatorname{Spec}q:\operatorname{Spec}E\to\operatorname{Spec}E$ for the induced morphism [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. (1) The $L$-algebra map $\varphi:E\otimes_LE\to\prod_{q\in Q}E$ [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property] with $\varphi(a\otimes b)=(a\,q(b))_{q\in Q}$ is an isomorphism. (2) Let $\pi:\operatorname{Spec}E\to\operatorname{Spec}L$ be induced by $L\subseteq E$, let $W=\operatorname{Spec}E\times_{\operatorname{Spec}L}\operatorname{Spec}E$ be the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $p_1,p_2:W\to\operatorname{Spec}E$, and let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of sets on the small etale site of $\operatorname{Spec}L$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] ($\operatorname{Spec}E$ and $W$ are etale over $\operatorname{Spec}L$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], and $p_1,p_2$ are morphisms of the site). Then there is a bijection $\beta:\mathcal F(W)\to\prod_{q\in Q}\mathcal F(\operatorname{Spec}E)$ such that for every $s\in\mathcal F(\operatorname{Spec}E)$ one has $\beta(s|_{p_1})=(s)_{q\in Q}$ and $\beta(s|_{p_2})=\bigl((\operatorname{Spec}q)^*s\bigr)_{q\in Q}$, where $s|_{p_i}=\mathcal F(p_i)(s)$ and $(\operatorname{Spec}q)^*s=\mathcal F(\operatorname{Spec}q)(s)$.

source.place: Tag 03SF, finite etale objects under a finite Galois extension (the decomposition of the base change into copies indexed by the Galois group)

proof.text: Construct the E-algebra map f:E tensor_L E -> (Q -> E) by AlgHom.pi of Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (AlgHom.id E E) q.toAlgHom. Its pure-tensor formula is definitionally f(a tensor b)(q)=a*q(b). Here E acts through the first factor. Dedekind independence, Mathlib linearIndependent_monoidHom restricted along the injective map from Q to multiplicative homomorphisms, gives E-linear independence of the functions q:E -> E. Mathlib span_flip_eq_top_iff_linearIndependent then says that the vectors (q(b))_q, as b runs over E, span E^Q. Each such vector is f(1 tensor b), so Submodule.span_le and LinearMap.range_eq_top prove that f is surjective.

As E-vector spaces, the source has dimension [E:L] by Module.finrank_baseChange, and the target has dimension |Q| by Module.finrank_pi. IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank identifies these dimensions. LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank turns surjectivity into injectivity. Apply AlgEquiv.ofBijective and restrictScalars L to get phi. Its pure-tensor formula is the formula already proved for f; no primitive element, polynomial quotient, root indexing, or CRT is needed.

The finite separable field extension gives Etale pi by Algebra.Etale.of_finite_of_isSeparable and HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff. Stability under base change makes pullback.fst pi pi etale, and stability under composition makes its composite with pi etale. Form the site objects U and V. Construct p1 and p2 by MorphismProperty.Over.homMk from the pullback projections, using pullback.condition for p2. Construct sigma(q) from Spec q; q.commutes and Spec.map_comp prove it is over Spec L.

source.place: Algebra.Etale.of_finite_of_isSeparable; Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Etale.lean, etale base change and composition

proof.text: Apply finiteGaloisTensorCoproduct to phi and its pure-tensor formula, obtaining e:coprod_Q Spec E ~= W, with first projection identity and second projection Spec q on component q. Define j(q):U -> V by Sigma.ι q followed by e.hom. The first projection equation proves the required over-base equation. MorphismProperty.Over.Hom.ext gives j(q) then p1 = id and j(q) then p2 = sigma(q). These equations fix the orientation without an inverse automorphism.

source.place: Tag 03SF, affine Galois-cover decomposition; finiteGaloisTensorCoproduct projection formulas

proof.text: The underlying j(q) are monomorphisms, being coprojections followed by an isomorphism; the faithful forgetful functor reflects monomorphisms in the site. Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff proves they cover: lift a point through e.hom, then use sigmaMk to find its component. Their ranges are disjoint: equality of image points cancels e.hom and sigmaι_eq_iff forces equal indices. Apply the proved Scheme.Etale.isIso_piLift_of_disjoint. Convert the categorical product into the type-theoretic product using Types.Small.productIso and equivShrink; Q is finite, so it is small in the sheaf value universe v even when u is larger. This gives bijectivity of s -> (F(j(q))(s))_q. Equiv.ofBijective defines beta with exactly this forward map.

For restriction along p1 or p2, rewrite F(j(q))(F(pi)(s)) by functoriality as F(j(q) then pi)(s). The component equations give F(id)(s)=s for p1 and F(sigma(q))(s) for p2. Package phi, the etale proofs, p1, p2, sigma, and beta into the unchanged conjunction and existential statement.

lean.statement: theorem finiteGaloisTensorDecomposition (L E : Type u) [Field L] [Field E] [Algebra L E] [FiniteDimensional L E] [IsGalois L E] (F : Sheaf ((Spec (CommRingCat.of L)).smallEtaleTopology) (Type v)) : (∃ φ : (E ⊗[L] E) ≃ₐ[L] ((E ≃ₐ[L] E) → E), ∀ (a b : E) (q : E ≃ₐ[L] E), φ (a ⊗ₜ[L] b) q = a * q b) ∧ (let π : Spec (CommRingCat.of E) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L) := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L E)) ∃ (hπ : Etale π) (hW : Etale (pullback.fst π π ≫ π)), letI : Etale π := hπ letI : Etale (pullback.fst π π ≫ π) := hW let U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)).Etale := .mk π let V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)).Etale := .mk (pullback.fst π π ≫ π) ∃ (p₁ p₂ : V ⟶ U) (σ : (E ≃ₐ[L] E) → (U ⟶ U)), p₁.left = pullback.fst π π ∧ p₂.left = pullback.snd π π ∧ (∀ q : E ≃ₐ[L] E, (σ q).left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom q.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)) ∧ ∃ β : F.obj.obj (Opposite.op V) ≃ ((E ≃ₐ[L] E) → F.obj.obj (Opposite.op U)), (∀ s q, β (F.obj.map p₁.op s) q = s) ∧ (∀ s q, β (F.obj.map p₂.op s) q = F.obj.map (σ q).op s))

reviewed_lean.note: IsGalois+FiniteDimensional L E; Q=E≃ₐ[L]E; (1) φ:(E⊗[L]E)≃ₐ[L](Q→E) Pi L-algebra, φ(a⊗b)q=a*q b (q on second factor); (2) π=Spec(algebraMap), W=pullback π π, p1/p2 pinned to pullback.fst/snd, σ q pinned to Spec q, β with p1↦const, p2↦(Spec q)^*s (consistent: component q ↔ a⊗b↦a q(b)); sheaf in Type v; no Mathlib/source match (grep FieldTheory/RingTheory, WeilConjectures); docstring follows the 6 proof steps
